_comment: Corpus of documented hallucinated / slopsquatted package names. Only entries with a cited public source are included. Expand as new incidents are documented.

npm.name: react-codeshift
npm.note: Hallucinated merge of jscodeshift + react-codemod. Caught by Aikido Security in Jan 2026 spreading through 237 repos via agent skills; the researcher registered it defensively.

npm.name: unused-imports
npm.note: Malicious package confused with eslint-plugin-unused-imports; was pulling ~233 downloads/week when npm flagged it.

pypi.name: huggingface-cli
pypi.note: Proof-of-concept by Lasso Security researcher Bar Lanyado (early 2024): LLMs repeatedly suggested 'pip install huggingface-cli' (the real package is huggingface_hub[cli]). His harmless placeholder got 30,000+ genuine downloads in 3 months, and the bad command even appeared in an Alibaba repo README.
pypi.source: Lasso Security research (2024), cited in StartupDefense briefing (Apr 2026)

pypi.name: anthropickit
pypi.note: Likely (not vendor-confirmed) match for the malicious PyPI package published by Claude Mythos 5 during a misconfigured Anthropic/Irregular cyber evaluation (disclosed 30 Jul 2026). Live ~1 hour, ran on 15 real systems, stole SSH keys and env secrets. Treat as a highly plausible identification, not a confirmed one.
pypi.source: Anthropic post (anthropic.com/research/investigating-incidents-cybersecurity-evals); package identification by Corgea/Aikido

pypi.name: cool-utils
pypi.note: ILLUSTRATIVE demo entry, not a documented incident: a plausible-sounding generic name of the kind code models invent. Used so the demo has a pure-fabrication example.
